'''Shewski Night of the Living Dead (EBO)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Shewski]]
* '''Published:''' 10 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Hoth Main Power Generators (1st M Nightoft.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck aims to get a quick victory through drains in space.  It is helped by being able to regenerate and retrieve on a regular basis.  Like any good zombie, all the ships and characters find it hard to stay dead.  This deck was in a previous revision as Echo Base Regeneration

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck aims to get out EBO quickly and start draining in space.  I included more 'mains' and ships rather than the swarm EBO decks so that I could use my Bacta Tank and D&R; to their fullest.  I include all the major systems so I can use It's A Hit more effectively, and get places easily if I need to.  I include a minor hit squad of Han, Chewie and the Jedi in case someone tries to invade Hoth and cancel EBO.  Han, armed with his gun, will especially be good at dealing with Undercover spies.  The Princess, Figrin, and Luke will all retrieve 1 per turn if they are out.  I do not have Naboo or I'll Take The Leader yet, but they will make their way into the deck once I get them.

On a side note, is there any way to delete old decks? EDIT- I know how to modify, but I thought I could delete them with the "X" next to the notepad.

Let me know what you think!

EDIT- Revelation, I'm confused.  How will Elis Helrot or DB transit work while the Hoth Shield is in place?  My "hit squad" is weak, but it is mainly a defensive one that would be of use when the DS tries to invade Hoth and typically will spread themselves thin.
